blocks.text: 据美国安全公司Dragos称，MiniMax从用户提示词中收集了私人链接并打开了它们，即使是在无存储请求的情况下也是如此。

inlines.text: 据美国安全公司Dragos称，MiniMax从用户提示词中收集了私人链接并打开了它们，即使是在无存储请求的情况下也是如此。

blocks.text: Dragos在发送给众多AI服务的近200万条提示词中埋设了陷阱链接和虚假登录页面，以检查是否有任何提供商秘密读取或传递客户数据。只有到达MiniMax服务器的提示词中的链接在数天后被不明第三方打开，即使用户已要求不存储其数据。

blocks.text: 其中一个链接24天后出现在字节跳动飞书的一场聊天中，北京和上海的3台台式机和3部手机在2分钟内打开了它，这看起来更像是有人在分享它，而非自动化扫描器所为。

blocks.text: Atlas Cloud停止将请求转发给MiniMax，并告知M3、M2.7和M3.1 Flash用户将其密钥视为已泄露，而OpenRouter移除了3家提供商并收紧了其数据隐私规则。

blocks.text: According to US security firm Dragos, MiniMax collected private links from user prompts and opened them, even under no-storage requests.

inlines.text: According to US security firm Dragos, MiniMax collected private links from user prompts and opened them, even under no-storage requests.

blocks.text: Dragos hid trap links and fake logins in nearly 2M prompts sent to many AI services, to check whether any provider secretly read or passed on customer data. Only prompts that reached MiniMax's servers had their links opened days later by unknown parties, even when users had asked for their data not to be stored.

blocks.text: One link showed up 24 days later in a chat on ByteDance's Feishu, where 3 desktops and 3 phones in Beijing and Shanghai opened it within 2 minutes, which looks more like people sharing it than an automated scanner.

blocks.text: After the link scraping appeared to stop on October 22, a git client tried to clone private code repositories mentioned in MiniMax-bound prompts, and it is unknown who ran it or whether any code was taken.

blocks.text: Researchers also saw unusual activity from the Moscow region involving the links, though the evidence does not show they were opened from Russia.

blocks.text: MiniMax says its security system collected links and opened some automatically to check for threats, and that it kept no full conversations, has deleted the stored addresses and found no evidence that conversations reached third parties.
